name: BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter
description: The BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter was the one-man version of the BTL-S3 starfighter model.

data.name: BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter
data.max_speed: 1000 km/h (higher speeds possible with deflector shields on)
data.engine: 2 Koensayr R200 ion jet engines (rated 250 KTU)
data.power: Novaldex power generator; Thiodyne 03-R cryogenic power cells and ionization reactor
data.sensor: Fabritech ANx-y long-range sensor array with PA-9r long range phased tachyon detection array and PG-7u short range primary threat analysis grid
data.target: Fabritech ANc 2.7 tracking computer with either the SI 5g7 "Quickscan" vector imaging system or the IN-344-B "Sightline" holographic imaging system
data.avionics: Subpro NH-7 flight control avionics package
armament: Taim & Bak IX4 or KX5 laser cannons (2)
Arakyd Flex Tube proton torpedo launchers (2)
